name: cloud-itonami-commitment-ledger
comment: V2 (docs/adr/0002-http-edge-live-registry-verification.md): shadow-cljs compiles src/commitledger/edge/*.cljc's :cljs branch (see shadow-cljs.edn :edge-api build) into functions/edge/commitment-edge-core.js, re-exported by the thin functions/api/commitment/*.js shims -- mirroring gftdcojp/cloud-itonami's own :edge-api build. shadow-cljs itself is not a devDependency here either (matching that repo's own package.json) -- `npx shadow-cljs` resolves it on demand; deps.edn's :cljs alias supplies the JVM-side thheller/shadow-cljs + clojurescript classpath shadow-cljs needs.
